symptom: On a phone, once a route is selected and the route planner panel is opened, the Clear Selection button is completely covered by the panel and cannot be tapped (elementFromPoint returns the panel's STARTING POINT label). On very short viewports (e.g. 320x480) the bottom-anchored map key grows up over the floating clear button and the zoom stack while the panel is closed.
rootcause: Two independent stacking failures. (1) The mobile layout in RomaniaSearch.module.css parked the floating clear button at a fixed `top: 66px; left: 10px` -- directly under the route launcher. But the launcher is replaced by the route planner panel at that same top-left anchor when the panel opens (RoutePlanner.module.css: `.panel { top: 10px; left: 10px; z-index: 30 }`), and the panel is tall (up to `calc(100% - 104px)` on short screens) and wider than the button's column. The panel's z-index (30) is above the clear button's (20), so the button is fully occluded. A fixed offset cannot know the panel's dynamic height, so no top-left position stays clear of both the open panel and the bottom-right map key. (2) The map key is bottom-anchored and grows upward, but its mobile `max-height` of `calc(100% - 136px)` budgeted only for the bottom playback panel. At 320x480 the key reached y=172 relative to the map while the clear button and zoom stack both end at y=106, so it covered each by 38-39px.
fix: Two fixes. (1) Lifted the planner `mode` state out of RoutePlanner into RomaniaSearch so the two components can coordinate. When the panel is explicitly open (`mode === "open"`) RomaniaSearch no longer renders the floating reset, and RoutePlanner renders its own `Clear` action inside the panel's action row (next to Run search) with `aria-label="Clear selection"`. The floating reset still serves the desktop and closed/auto states, so exactly one clear control is mounted at a time. (2) MapLegend.module.css now reserves the top control row as well as the bottom panel: `max-height: calc(100% - 200px)`, or `calc(100% - 232px)` while playback is expanded (the key sits 32px higher). The key scrolls inside that band instead of covering the clear or zoom controls. The header wrap rule was also widened from `max-width: 560px` to the full mobile range (`max-width: 800px`) so the brand row wraps instead of clipping under larger fonts.
automation_gap: jsdom applies no layout, so a vitest test cannot detect element occlusion or overlap; the interaction is covered by two cases in components/search/RomaniaSearch.test.tsx -- `cycles the route planner auto -> open -> closed -> open while keeping the selected route` (selection survives every transition, exactly one clear action per state) and `clears the selected route from the open route planner panel` (the panel's own clear action empties the route) -- but the visual overlap itself needs a real browser. Catching it automatically would need a Playwright-style layout assertion, and the repo deliberately has no such runner/dependency (see the frontend-test rule in CLAUDE.md).
notes: The zoom controls are covered by the open panel for the same reason (panel z-index 30 over the map controls' 20). That is left as-is: the panel is a foreground overlay the visitor dismisses with its own collapse button, and moving the map controls out of the panel's footprint would require a mobile panel redesign. The clear action is different because it is the only way to clear the route.
